episodes.title: The Big Pitch
episodes.logline: A young Nairobi developer lands a game-changing fintech client meeting, but an unruly matatu and a dead laptop battery threaten to ruin everything.
episodes.synopsis: Brian receives an urgent call from Mary to pitch his AI financial assistant to senior venture investors at 2:00 PM in Kilimani. Kevin insists on escorting him, leading to a hilarious chain reaction involving an impromptu detour through Gikomba, a forgotten charger, and an emergency sprint through Nairobi traffic.

threeActStructure.beginning: Brian wakes up to Mary's surprise call scheduling a multi-million shilling venture pitch in 2 hours.
threeActStructure.conflict: Kevin convinces Brian to take a notorious express nganya matatu that takes a wild unplanned detour.
threeActStructure.escalation: Brian's laptop battery dips to 4% while stuck in a major roundabout jam on Uhuru Highway.
threeActStructure.climax: Brian and Kevin abandon the vehicle and sprint across downtown Nairobi, arriving at the boardroom with seconds to spare.
threeActStructure.resolution: Brian delivers the pitch verbally with Kevin providing dynamic live whiteboard sketches; the board is captivated.
threeActStructure.endingHook: Mary smiles and tells Brian they got the funding—but the investor wants the prototype live in 48 hours.
